entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Vessel hauled behind the Weatherlight like a casket.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Angel who hurt Mirri and Crovax.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Man whose soul bears wounds Selenia tore.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem and keeper of the Legacy artifacts.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: Victim of Volrath's theft of dreams.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: Soltari emissary who speaks with Urza.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Hero who reassures Sisay and bests Greven.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin whose cooking makes people sick.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Wizard in whose name Lyna speaks.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Artificial plane where souls are limited.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian master praised in Stronghold writings.

entities.name: il-Kor
entities.description: Kor who no longer roam the plains.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: Collection of artifacts recovered by Karn and Hanna.

events.summary: The Weatherlight hauls the Predator behind it.
Selenia hurt Mirri badly and tore wounds in Crovax's soul that will not close.
Mirri follows Crovax's skulking form despite exhaustion.
events.quote: she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

events.summary: Ertai asks whether that was all.
Lyna asks Urza what to do now that the enemy is gone; Urza says they wait.
Takara says Volrath stole everything of her.
events.quote: Volrath stole everything there was of me.

events.summary: Karn and Hanna stand over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents.
events.quote: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts

events.summary: Sisay, injured, asks about her ship and Gerrard assures her it is intact.
Greven il-Vec threatens to flay Gerrard.
events.quote: I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry.

events.summary: Gerrard bests Greven by sacrificing defense.
events.quote: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

events.summary: Flowstone lunges at the Weatherlight, seeming to take on Greven's rage.
events.quote: it lunged like a wild beast at the *Weatherlight*.

events.summary: Lyna cries that Ertai reports the portal is open though not for long.
events.quote: Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!

events.summary: Orim writes that never has she seen so many made sick, and that they will never eat Squee's cooking again.
events.quote: We will *never* eat Squee's cooking again.

events.summary: Hanna doubts what the skyshaper will do to the ship.
events.quote: I can't guarantee what it'll do to the ship.

events.summary: Eladamri says Volrath is not the only one who can shape the world.
events.quote: Volrath is not the only one who can shape this world to serve him.

events.summary: Volrath says his enemies' death yields removal, reuse and research.
events.quote: My enemies' death yields threefold benefit: removal, reuse, and research.

relations.quote: Volrath stole everything there was of me.

relations.note: They stand together over the Legacy.

relations.quote: Lyna turned to the figure beside her.
